llm_assumption_review.policy: Every paper-facing theorem premise not derived from prior Lean declarations must be declared in Assumptions.lean, listed in assumption_names, and judged by an independent LLM as a paper/source model assumption, paper-statement condition, or documented caveat rather than a proof assumption.

llm_statement_review.policy: For every selected source claim, compare only its exact byte-pinned raw source-anchor bundle and Lean's expanded transparent `...Spec : Prop` target. The paired proof endpoint receives separate Lean-Meta proof credit; a name, paraphrase, wrapper, or prior aggregate receipt is not a semantic match. Review every retained paper-local prerequisite and every material library prerequisite before the dependent claim.

source_proof_fidelity_review.policy: Minor printed formula/domain slips are formalized notes only when surrounding source semantics uniquely determine the correction and Lean checks the repaired target plus comparison evidence. Here Lean checks the strict-variance closed/interior split with both endpoint counterexamples, Equation 20 with the uniquely implied Beta(C,1-C) shape, and corrected Equation 21 with its printed zero-prior special case. A weaker unresolved target or a non-source theorem premise would instead require partial status.
